Subject: AptusData pilot — PO requirement, onboarding forms, and temporary exception request

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for agreeing to the two-week pilot. A couple of quick items on our side so we can set up billing and provisioning:

- We have a standard vendor intake form and W-9 that we need on file (attached).
- Our procurement team typically requires a Purchase Order (PO) for any vendor work. For short pilots we can sometimes approve a temporary invoice-only path while procurement completes the vendor setup.

To move fast, can you confirm: 1) whether AptusData will issue a PO for this pilot or 2) whether procurement can accept invoices (Net 30) and a signed SOW instead? If (2), please confirm invoicing email and remittance address.

I attached the vendor-intake-form and a draft SOW — the pilot budget is estimated at ~$3,800. If procurement needs an approval ladder or evidence, we can surface the payment cap and a one-time exception request.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You send back the completed intake + W-9
2) Confirm PO vs invoice-only preference
3) If invoice-only, I'll route an exception request internally with a proposed cap and evidence checklist.

CCing Marissa and Lauren from ops/procurement for visibility.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks — attached is our vendor setup packet and a scanned W-9 (see attachments). Our preferred route is to issue a PO for engagements; however, we can accept invoice-only for pilots if Redwood can provide a purchase order exception letter or an internal approval showing the approval authority and dollar cap.

Procurement note: procurement@aptusdata.com requires vendor tax info + proof of SOW and a billing contact. If you can route an internal exception with the proposed dollar cap and timeframe, we can accept Net 30 invoices and provide payment within standard terms while we await a formal PO.

Let me know what evidence your team needs; we can also push a PO if it speeds things up.

Best,

Ben / Lauren —

Reviewed. Approve temporary invoice-only path for the AptusData pilot under the following conditions:

- Approval cap: $5,000 (one-time, pilot only)
- Required documents on file before provisioning: signed SOW, completed vendor intake, W-9 (all attached)
- Invoices must be submitted to finance@redwood.ai with the subject line: "Pilot — AptusData — Invoice" and include SOW reference
- Finance will process Net 30. This exception expires 30 days from approval date or upon receipt of a formal PO, whichever comes first.
- Risk controls: legal to review SOW for indemnities and data handling; account team to confirm no PHI or restricted data usage during pilot.

Lauren: please create a short internal exception memo and add AptusData to the temporary vendor allowlist in the vendor portal. I will note the approval in the procurement tracker and notify Ben to proceed.

Thanks,
